# Vendored Hershey data

Source: [kamalmostafa/hershey-fonts](https://github.com/kamalmostafa/hershey-fonts/tree/1356bf2f83d380fcef68c887e88675eb9d445d86), exact revision `1356bf2f83d380fcef68c887e88675eb9d445d86`.

- `rowmans.jhf`: upstream `hershey-fonts/rowmans.jhf`, Roman Simplex, 96 records.
- `rowmand.jhf`: upstream `hershey-fonts/rowmand.jhf`, Roman Duplex, 96 records.
- `rowmant.jhf`: upstream `hershey-fonts/rowmant.jhf`, Roman Triplex, 96 records.
- `scripts.jhf`: upstream `hershey-fonts/scripts.jhf`, Script Simplex, 96 records.
- `NOTICE.txt`: upstream `hershey-fonts/hershey-fonts.notes`, preserved verbatim.

The upstream notes credit Dr. A. V. Hershey, James Hurt, and the distribution contributors. They allow use for any purpose with attribution/acknowledgment restrictions and prohibit conversion into the original NTIS distribution format. Read and retain [the complete terms](NOTICE.txt) when redistributing or deriving fonts. This is a separate license from project MIT. No upstream C code is vendored.

The [font catalog](../../fonts/README.md) links each face's mapping, normalization, source digest, editable package, and export. All four come from the same pinned revision and retain the same notice. The committed data makes preparation reproducible without a network dependency. Each face is selected explicitly; other Hershey repertoires need their own mapping review.
